# Constantine Mureev

> Personal site of Constantine Mureev — engineering leader shaping fintech at
> Renmoney, based in Yoshkar-Ola, Russia. The site itself is an interactive
> terminal, hand-rolled in vanilla JavaScript with zero runtime dependencies.

You are reading the briefing meant for agents. The human version of this page
boots into a terminal at https://mureev.com/ — the facts are the same.

## Who

- Constantine Mureev (Константин Муреев) — engineering leader.
- Builds high-performing teams; believes in good people, curiosity & hard work.
- Currently shaping fintech at Renmoney (https://renmoney.com).
- In software since September 2009; leading teams since 2012.
- Based in Yoshkar-Ola, Russia (UTC+3). Russian native, English bilingual.

## Colophon

The terminal is written by hand — no frameworks, no build step, one
self-contained HTML file whose source is documented for readers like you.
